content.text:
I have now read the full agreement (all sections). No hiring or solicitation restriction exists anywhere.

- §5.4 (planner hint) only appoints General Managers as liaisons — no personnel restriction.
- §6 Exclusivity restricts competing web projects/brand use, not hiring.
- §8 Confidentiality, §9 Warranties, §10 General Provisions contain no non-solicit or no-hire.
- Searches for "solicit", "employ", "hire", "personnel", "induce", "staff" return only incidental references (employees/agents in the confidentiality carve-out; "agent, partner, employee or representative" in the no-joint-venture clause) — neither restricts the Company from soliciting or hiring HDI personnel.

The Company is therefore subject to no non-solicitation restriction, which is our preferred position. No redline is warranted.

input.quote: This Agreement is the complete and exclusive agreement between the Parties with respect to the subject matter hereof, superseding any prior agreements and communications (both written and oral) regarding such subject matter.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-solicitation or no-hire covenant binding the Company. Section 5.4 (the planner's candidate location) merely appoints a General Manager on each side as liaison and imposes no hiring restriction; Article 6 Exclusivity restricts competing Internet projects and brand use only; Articles 8-10 contain no personnel covenant. Targeted searches for "solicit", "employ", "hire", "personnel", "induce" and "staff" return only incidental references (HDI's "employees, or agents" in the confidentiality carve-out at 8.1(c) and "agent, partner, employee or representative" in the no-joint-venture clause at 10.2), neither of which restricts the Company from soliciting or hiring HDI personnel. The integration clause confirms no such covenant sits elsewhere. This meets our preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer), so no redline is proposed.
